verified: Three routes complete with HITL off even when a further guidance call would fail.
Pack write failure invalidates completion; missing checks cannot be delivered by model instruction.
Collected file groups plus unknown intake cannot show a full progress bar.
Different same-named attachments retain distinct bytes and original names.
Final real mail shows one sample warning, original filename, emoji, progress and questions; no completion or pack.
retained_findings: Initial copy revision lost official reference and inside-UK scope details; regressions fixed before final passing suite.
First actual sample email repeated the warning and exposed a filename prefix; second actual email verifies the repair.
limits: Synthetic positive case is not an actual visa/customer acceptance.
No document authenticity detection or legal approval; no full formal material set completed through email.
Old unusable files/conflicts are not automatically retired or resolved; may need operator intervention or a fresh case.
QQ cumulative budget is separate from the one-request completion experiment; no production uptime or automatic recovery claim.
